items.headline: 49ers' Brock Purdy beats Vikings blitz, hears 'MVP' chants in Mexico City
items.description: Quarterback Brock Purdy heard "MVP" chants in Mexico City and continued to earn praise from his teammates as he led the 49ers to a statement victory against the top-ranked Vikings defense on Sunday night
